name: Empty
summary: The placeholder for a surface that has no data yet.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-empty> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Empty is a small family: an `image` (a 64×41 line-art illustration by default, or a smaller `simple` graphic for tight surfaces, or a custom picture via slot="image"), a caption from the `description` attribute or the default slot (description="" hides it), and an optional action (slot="action"). A static marker — no interactive state, so no motion. Zero drift — the same element.
codeNote: The built-in illustration is the component's own line-art graphic, drawn with currentColor from a token-bound host colour — not a catalogue glyph; slot="image" can supersede it with any picture (e.g. an <aha-icon>). Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: image
props.desc: Built-in illustration: 64×41 line art, or a smaller 48×30 low-key graphic for tight surfaces

props.name: description
props.desc: The caption; falls back to the default slot when absent, and renders nothing when set to ""

props.name: image
props.desc: A custom picture (e.g. an <aha-icon>) that supersedes the built-in illustration

props.name: action
props.desc: An optional call to action (a button or link)

whenToUse.when: a list, table, or panel has nothing to show yet
reporting the outcome of an action (success, 404)

opinion.note: The caption says what's missing and, ideally, the next step — 'No responses yet — share the join link'. Keep one action; an empty state is a nudge, not a menu.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 <Empty> component-set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy: <Empty> set + Empty/Customize + a separate Illustration component), matching antd Empty's matrix: a default illustration vs a smaller `simple` image, a `description` (or none), a custom picture (Customize / slot="image"), and an optional action. Colour/size derived from the token layer (text-tertiary caption, text-disabled art) — a deliberate extension, not a per-cell measured match.
